description: Source code for shell log backend implementation in Zephyr RTOS, handling log message processing, enabling/disabling backend, panic handling, and message copying.

methods.name: z_shell_log_backend_output_func
methods.description: Outputs log data to shell stream, returns length of data processed.

methods.name: fifo_reset
methods.description: Resets the FIFO buffer in the shell log backend.

methods.name: z_shell_log_backend_enable
methods.description: Enables the shell log backend, sets mode, resets FIFO, and activates logging.

methods.name: z_shell_log_backend_process
methods.description: Processes pending log messages, handles dropped messages, and manages colors.

methods.name: panic
methods.description: Handles panic state, flushes logs, and moves cursor to start of next line.

methods.name: copy_to_pbuffer
methods.description: Copies log message to multi-producer single-consumer buffer.

methods.name: process_log_msg
methods.description: Processes a single log message, handling locking and color formatting.

methods.name: process_msg_from_buffer
methods.description: Claims and processes a message from the buffer.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main processing function for log backend, handles different backend states.
